description: Guards the funnel depends on: secrets never reach a transcript unless the repository opened them (kit env-access), a green suite cannot be faked, a gate's tool never runs without the environment its gate gives it, and the pull request body, and every comment the funnel writes on a pull request or a Jira issue, stays under the budget the skill asks for and nobody checked. The PreToolUse ones run in one interpreter through hooks/guards.py, which prefilters by substring before importing any of them: registered separately they spent three interpreter startups, measured at 13 ms each, on every Bash call to answer no. The Stop hook asks a turn that changed code in a funnel checkout to have run kit gate after it. The em dash hook rides the same dispatcher but stays opt-in behind KIT_NO_EM_DASH, because it is a house style rather than a correctness property.
